{{Top|leg}}
The '''Echani battle stimulant''' was a [[Stimulant/Legends|stim]] composed of a chemical cocktail that sent a boost of adrenaline through the body, focusing the mind and increasing the user's tolerance for damage. This resulted in the user having the ability to maneuver faster. The effect would wear off after a short period of time.
